disposition.reason: Craig Santenello appealed the Morrisville DRB's site plan approval of a new 16-unit apartment building replacing a duplex, which is new housing.

evidence.quote: The approved plan calls for an existing residential duplex to be razed and replaced with a 16-unit residential apartment building.
Craig Santenello (“Appellant”) filed a timely appeal of the DRB approval with this Court.

project.description: Site plan for a 16-unit residential apartment building replacing an existing duplex to be razed, a second development on a parcel where a separate 9-unit building is under construction

evidence.quote: The approved plan calls for an existing residential duplex to be razed and replaced with a 16-unit residential apartment building.

municipal_decision.description: Town of Morrisville Development Review Board approved AHL Investments LP's site plan application

evidence.quote: When the Town of Morrisville Development Review Board (“DRB”) approved Applicant’s site plan application
Craig Santenello (“Appellant”) filed a timely appeal of the DRB approval with this Court.
Appellant here has not alleged that he lives in the immediate area.

discretion.description: The appellant's grounds for challenging the approval are not stated; the only decided issue was his standing, on which he filed no response.

observed_status.description: The appeal was dismissed for lack of standing, leaving the DRB site plan approval in place; nothing further is shown pending.

evidence.quote: Appellant Craig Santenello lacks standing to bring this appeal and that this appeal must therefore be DISMISSED.
This concludes the matter before the Court.

judgments.note: Appeal of a municipal DRB site plan approval for a new 16-unit apartment building (replacing a duplex): new housing.
